run_preview_command: run the doc_builder preview command to build and serve documentation with live reload
build_preview_command_parser: build an argparse parser for the doc_builder preview CLI with library name, path, language, and version arguments
start_watcher_for_docs: start a file watcher that rebuilds mdx files when source documentation files change
start_sveltekit_dev_server: start a sveltekit dev server with node dependencies installed in a temporary directory
create_watch_event_handler: create a file system event handler that triggers incremental doc builds on file create or modify events
